feature: Foreground scenery does not obscure the full robot silhouette

implementation.projection: Conservative camera-axis AABBs project every child mesh and full player renderer/capsule bounds, including feet, head and weapons. Works with orthographic parallel viewing and standard perspective. No sparse ray holes; Collider not required.
implementation.grouping: IntercomOccluder on a house root groups roof/walls/trim; closest nested marker wins. Setup marks existing prototype houses, crates and barriers together; boundary walls individually; ground excluded.
implementation.visibility: Immediate forceRenderingOff; restores original value after 0.18 seconds clear. No material mutation; Renderer.enabled, GameObject.activeSelf and physical colliders unchanged. Shared leases prevent two cameras from restoring each other prematurely.
implementation.caching: Scene renderer discovery on enable, loaded/unloaded scene, target change, marker revision or explicit RefreshScenery only. Bounds and overlap tested every LateUpdate after camera follow. No per-frame global Find. Visibility is rechecked before this camera renders (URP beginCameraRendering / Built-in onPreCull), covering scene changes after LateUpdate.
implementation.dynamic_objects: Spawn buildings with an enabled IntercomOccluder on their root for automatic same-frame registration. After adding unmarked runtime scenery, call RefreshScenery().
implementation.exclusions: Player hierarchy; known projectile pool; non-mesh renderers; explicit disabled/false marker; thin floor markings close to capsule bottom. Elevated thin roofs are included. Camera cullingMask and sceneryLayers respected.
implementation.ownership: Hide state releases when camera component disables/destroys, target disappears/inactivates/changes, scene topology refreshes or renderer clears the silhouette.

limits: Conservative AABB projection can hide a building slightly before its visible pixels touch the robot, especially with rotated/irregular buildings. This deliberately favours character visibility.
Visibility removes the whole grouped building immediately rather than using alpha transparency; arbitrary imported materials/shaders are supported without conversion.
Runtime-spawned unmarked objects require RefreshScenery; adding IntercomOccluder to spawned building prefabs avoids that requirement.
Custom oblique camera projection matrices and incorrect authored renderer bounds are outside this prototype.
manual_checks: At a low side-on camera, run behind every test building and crate: entire foreground group disappears before head, hands or boots are obscured.
Two foreground buildings overlapping the silhouette both hide; buildings behind or beside the robot remain.
Object with Renderer but no Collider still hides.
Stop/reset/disable camera occlusion: original renderer state returns; colliders continue blocking movement and bullets.
Repeat Setup: no duplicate components and existing hideWhenBlocking exclusions retained.
Spawn a prefab with IntercomOccluder and child roof/wall meshes: it is registered before the next rendered frame.
